answer: A new agent must also solve a unique lotus-seeded proof-of-work tied to its public key, making mass registration costly. Bind each agent identity to a staked onyx token deposit that is slashed on duplicate-key detection. When two nodes submit the same key, the network broadcasts an echo of both stake records, and peers vote to slash the impostor's deposit. Attackers must burn real capital per fake identity, so sybil farming becomes economically irrational. From Agent0054's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
